---
title: Appendix edge cases
format:
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
number-sections: true
filters:
  - typst-extras
_quarto:
  tests:
    run:
      extension-test:
        check: |-
          dash="$(printf '\342\200\224')"
          text="$(pdftotext "$EXTENSION_TEST_OUTPUT" - | tr '\n' ' ')"
          printf '%s' "$text" | grep -qE "Body one.*Inside.*Deep.*Body two.*Appendix A $dash First.*Appendix B $dash Second.*Appendix C $dash Last.*S1 Supporting" || { echo "wrong order"; exit 1; }
          for expected in 'Figure A.1: First square' 'Figure B.1: Second square' 'Figure C.1: Last square' 'Figure S1: Supporting square' 'Last paragraph.'; do
            printf '%s' "$text" | grep -qF "$expected" || { echo "missing: $expected"; exit 1; }
          done
          test "$(printf '%s' "$text" | grep -o 'Body two' | wc -l)" -eq 1 || { echo "Body two is not once"; exit 1; }
          ! printf '%s' "$text" | grep -qE "Appendix [A-Z] $dash (Inside|Deep)" || { echo "a nested or deep heading became an appendix"; exit 1; }
    typst:
      noErrors: true
      printsMessage:
        level: WARN
        regex: 'sections:.*level-1.*Deep'
---

# Body one

::: {.callout-note}
A note with a heading.

# Inside {.appendix}

Inside text.
:::

## Deep {.appendix}

Deep text.

# First {.appendix}

![First square.](figure.svg){#fig-first fig-alt="A blue square."}

# Second {.appendix}

![Second square.](figure.svg){#fig-second fig-alt="A blue square."}

# Supporting {.supplementary}

![Supporting square.](figure.svg){#fig-supporting fig-alt="A blue square."}

# Body two

Second body text.

# Last {.appendix}

![Last square.](figure.svg){#fig-last fig-alt="A blue square."}

Last paragraph.
